name: Icon Button
description: Icon buttons help people take supplementary actions with a single tap. They display an icon without a text label.

variants.name: Standard
variants.description: Icon button without background, lowest emphasis

variants.name: Filled
variants.description: Icon button with solid background, highest emphasis

variants.name: Filled Tonal
variants.description: Icon button with tonal background, medium emphasis

variants.name: Outlined
variants.description: Icon button with outline border, medium emphasis

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the icon button

props.name: softDisabled
props.description: Disabled but still focusable for accessibility

props.name: toggle
props.description: Whether the button toggles between selected states

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the toggle button is selected

props.name: href
props.description: URL to navigate to, making the button a link

props.name: flipIconInRtl
props.description: Flips the icon in RTL layouts

props.name: ariaLabelSelected
props.description: Aria label when toggle button is selected

events.name: click
events.description: Fired when the button is clicked

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when a toggle button toggles

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when a toggle button state changes

slots.name: selected
slots.description: Icon to display when toggle is selected

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Always requires aria-label since there is no visible text. For toggle buttons, provide aria-label-selected for selected state.
accessibility.focusManagement: Receives focus in tab order. Use soft-disabled for better discoverability in toolbars.

antiPatterns: Using icon button for primary actions
Icon that is not universally recognizable without label
Too many icon buttons without grouping
llm.semanticMeaning: Compact button for supplementary or toggle actions
